commit 09a7d0ffb8dafd2527ab7cf5068c73f0aaa31d66
Author:     Rob Lemley <rob@calypsoblue.org>
AuthorDate: Mon Oct 6 11:29:44 2025 +0100
Commit:     Rob Lemley <rob@calypsoblue.org>
CommitDate: Mon Oct 6 11:29:44 2025 +0100

    Bug 1991479 - Use correct Windows runtime for ASan builds. r=#thunderbuild
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D266699

diff --git a/third_party/openpgp.configure b/third_party/openpgp.configure
index 5fda5a9d780..14d90c67508 100644
--- a/third_party/openpgp.configure
+++ b/third_party/openpgp.configure
@@ -213,6 +213,7 @@ with only_when(in_tree_librnp):
             cxx_compiler,
             milestone,
             stdcxx_compat,
+            asan,
             target_sysroot.bootstrapped,
             target_sysroot.path,
         )
@@ -233,6 +234,7 @@ with only_when(in_tree_librnp):
             cxx_compiler,
             milestone,
             stdcxx_compat,
+            is_asan,
             bootstrapped,
             sysroot_path,
         ):
@@ -341,7 +343,7 @@ with only_when(in_tree_librnp):
                 ]
                 botan_flags += [
                     "--cc=msvc",  # This forces MSVC style arguments out of Botan with clang-cl
-                    "--msvc-runtime=MT",
+                    "--msvc-runtime={}".format("MD" if is_asan else "MT"),
                     "--extra-cxxflags={}".format(" ".join(win_cxx_flags)),
                 ]
             if bootstrapped:
title: Bug 1991479 - Use correct Windows runtime for ASan builds. r=#thunderbuild
